cell_line.evidence: SILAC labeling of cells: HEK293 Flp-In T-Rex cells were cultured in SILAC-DMEM high glucose medium (AC-LM-0065, Anprotec) supplemented with 10% dialyzed FBS, 2 mM L-glutamine, 1 mM sodium pyruvate and 50 µg/ml uridine and either heavy or light amino acids of L-arginine (100 mg/l) and L-lysine (140 mg/l).
